court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Shasta
case_search_note: Public Portal linked from Court Case Records. Works without registration (registered users without privileged access see the same as the public). Some records restricted from remote display (CRC 2.503) can be viewed at Records, 1515 Court St. Not the official record.

courthouses.name: Redding Main Courthouse
courthouses.note: Only courthouse listed; Departments 21–64 and Jury Assembly. Hears criminal (felony & misdemeanor arraignments, trials) and traffic. Courtroom doors generally open 8:00 a.m. — go to your assigned courtroom. Criminal email Criminal@shasta.courts.ca.gov; Traffic email Traffic@shasta.courts.ca.gov; fax (530) 999-2003. (530) 245-6789 is listed for both Criminal and Traffic.

legal_aid.name: Legal Services of Northern California — Redding Office
legal_aid.serves: Lassen, Modoc, Shasta, Siskiyou and Tehama counties
legal_aid.what: Civil legal aid: housing, public benefits, education rights, health benefits, grandparent guardianship. No criminal defense or record clearance listed. 1370 West Street, Redding, CA 96001. Hours Mon/Tue/Wed/Fri 9–11:45 & 1–4:45, Thu 1–4:45. After-hours intake message line (866) 815-5990.

legal_aid.name: Shasta Superior Court — Family Law Facilitator / Self Help Center
legal_aid.what: Forms help and general information; Room 320, Main Courthouse. States it does NOT assist with criminal cases (may give outside referrals). Walk-in hours are in a PDF on the page.

programs.name: Addicted Offender Program (AOP)
programs.summary: For repeat offenders with substance abuse problems. DA and Probation set eligibility; admission is at the court's discretion. Participants plead guilty, sign an agreement, attend status hearings and are monitored by a probation officer; graduates have charges dismissed.

programs.name: Sheriff's Work Release
programs.summary: Alternative to continuous jail confinement, ordered by the court at sentencing; the Sheriff decides eligibility — (530) 245-6720.

programs.name: Fines converted to community service
programs.summary: Court page: fines can be converted to community service at $33.00/hour; court-imposed fees cannot be converted.

jails.name: Shasta County Jail
jails.phone_note: Court's Criminal Division page: call the Sheriff at (530) 245-6100 for jail inmate information.
jails.note: High-security local detention facility attached to the Justice Center and courts (per search-index summary of the Sheriff page). Visits by request form submitted at least 7 days ahead (no more than 30). That page reportedly noted in-person visits were suspended from Sept 26, 2025 for construction — check current status. court_ids: only courthouse in county.
